the FLEX approximation is a good scheme for the superconducting fluctuation transport.

the Boltzmann-equation approach in the FLEX approximation is equivalent to the Fermi- liquid theory in the conventional schemes, and the Boltzmann- equation approach in the FEX approximation is not equivalent to the Fermiliquid theory in the conventional scheme.
